chunks: If it is said: Does the inquisitor not have the choice between speaking about the Imamate of Ibn Hasan (peace be upon him) to know its validity or invalidity, and speaking about the reason for the occultation?

key_terms.ابْنُ الْحَسَنِ: Ibn al-Hasan (referring to Imam al-Hasan al-Askari, peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What is the choice between verifying Imamate and investigating the reason for occultation?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi structures this rhetorical inquiry to highlight the dual approach of Shia scholarship: establishing the factual validity of Imam al-Hasan al-Askari's Imamah before delving into the theological wisdom of his concealment. This distinction underscores the methodological rigor required to refute skeptics who questioned the continuity of the Imamate during the Minor and Major Occultations.
